newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin rebounds on increased demand.
newsitem.headline: KL tin rebounds on increased demand.

text.p: Tin price rebounded to close 17 cents stronger at 14.97 ringgit ($5.94) a kg after a higher London market overnight triggered off more buying from overseas, traders said.

"The market is firm and expects to move up to 15 ringgit if copper continues its upward trend in London," a trader said, adding that gains were also attributed to increased buying from Europe and Malaysia. Turnover rose to 105 tonnes from 85 on Wednesday. The local price differential over London was at a $15 premium against a discount of $15 on Wednesday.
